title: Clásicos Castellanos: Libro de Buen Amor
summary: "Clásicos Castellanos: Libro de Buen Amor" by Juan Ruiz is a work written between 1330 and 1343. This extensive Spanish medieval masterpiece weaves together over 1,700 varied verses through a fictional autobiography of the author's romantic adventures. The Archpriest of Hita chronicles encounters with women from all levels of society, aided by the go-between Trotaconventos. Blending fables, allegories, religious hymns, satirical poems, and parodic battles, this heterogeneous collection showcases the rich tapestry of medieval Spanish literature.
